snippet.title: Horizon 1990 | announcement trailer
snippet.description:
We from 16 BIT NIGHTS want to humbly announce that we just set live the coming soon page for our 6th upcoming game. 

About the game:
Gather exotic resources, build defenses, research new technologies, and explore the mysteries of the void, all while being chased by the darkness from the end of time.

Many asked about a reference point for the gameplay, in this case, this game is similar to "Kingdom classic" and "Until we die" but with a lot more action and management with more depth + a dash of "FTL".

We would appreciate if you smash that wishlist button without mercy! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4398490/Horizon_1990/

Trailer Music by:
By Sjellos from Silentsphere Studios
You can check out his awesome music here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgLQySmgXGtuQ8ibiOTF5gw

You can find us on our Discord for live chat here:
https://discord.gg/NDHUvdtaCv
